description: Two rooms signed in turn: each room's own receipts are numbered 1 to n and link to each other.

pointers./chain/room_numbering/does_not_show/0: That nothing was still running in the room when the list was read, or that no receipt was signed after it. There is no closed verdict for an ordinary room.
pointers./chain/room_numbering/shows/0: No receipt of this room is missing from this list, between its first receipt and its last.
